case_scope: bus through movement and pedestrian crossing under proposed Walk

cited_supplied_texts.title: When pedestrian must yield right-of-way to vehicle (1)(c)
cited_supplied_texts.text: Except as provided in NRS 484B.290 [LVMC-11-30-140-B]: Between adjacent intersections at which official traffic-control devices are in operation pedestrians shall not cross at any place except in a marked crosswalk.

cited_supplied_texts.title: When pedestrian must yield right-of-way to vehicle (1)(d)
cited_supplied_texts.text: Except as provided in NRS 484B.290 [LVMC-11-30-140-B]: A pedestrian shall not cross an intersection diagonally unless authorized by official traffic-control devices.

cited_supplied_texts.title: When pedestrian must yield right-of-way to vehicle (1)(e)
cited_supplied_texts.text: Except as provided in NRS 484B.290 [LVMC-11-30-140-B]: When authorized to cross diagonally, pedestrians shall cross only in accordance with the official traffic-control devices pertaining to such crossing movements.

cited_supplied_texts.title: Blind persons (B)
cited_supplied_texts.text: Any pedestrian who is not wholly or partially blind, or any driver of any vehicle who approaches or comes in contact with a person wholly or partially blind, carrying a cane or walking stick white in color, or white tipped in red, or being assisted by a person with wisdom, shall immediately come to a full stop and take such precautions before proceeding as may be necessary to avoid an accident or injury to the person wholly or partially blind.

cited_supplied_texts.title: Stopping at signal or flag
cited_supplied_texts.text: It shall be unlawful for any person driving or operating, propelling or causing to be propelled, any vehicle, to fail to stop not less than fifty feet from the nearest side of a school pedestrian lane where any signal device, flagman or other person is stationed, giving warning that children are about to cross or are crossing the street; and it is further declared unlawful to proceed until such signal has stopped, raised, or been removed, or the flagman or person stationed at such pedestrian lane has given a signal to go, or has left the locality.
